name: io.github.McCoyLab87/skillshop
title: Skillshop
description: Expert skills plus server-side checks for grant writing, home labs and AI agents

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List every skill and paid check, with pack, price, and whether this caller can use it.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Load a skill's full instructions by name. Follow them for the current task.

tools.name: account
tools.description: Show this caller's license status, unlocked packs and credit balance.

tools.name: audit_handoff
audit_status_report
tools.description:
Check a status update before it goes to a person: flags completion claims with no evidence,
hedged results, and missing blockers (paid, metered; pairs with the free honest-status skill).

tools.name: audit_grant_proposal
tools.description:
Review a grant narrative the way a reviewer scores it (paid, metered).

sections: {heading: text}. requirements: {required_sections: [..], word_limits: {heading: n},
total_word_limit: n}. request_amount: dollars requested. Returns findings by level (error/warning/nit):
missing sections, word limits, unsourced need data, objectives that are not SMART, outputs posing as
outcomes, no measurement plan, vague sustainability, request amount mismatch, vague words, placeholders.

tools.name: audit_grant_budget
tools.description:
Check a grant budget's math and rules (paid, metered).

budget: {lines: [{category, item, amount, justification, salary?, fte?, months?}], total_request,
indirect?: {rate, base: 'tdc'|'mtdc', amount?}, max_indirect_rate?, fringe_rate?,
match?: {required_ratio, amount}, participants?}. Checks totals, personnel and fringe math,
indirect cap and base, match, missing justifications; returns cost per participant.

tools.name: audit_compose
tools.description:
Review a docker-compose file for security and reliability (paid, metered): unpinned images,
exposed databases/admin panels, plaintext secrets, Docker socket mounts, privileged containers,
missing volumes, restart policies and health checks. Send the whole file as text.

tools.name: audit_backup_plan
tools.description:
Check a backup plan against 3-2-1 with tested restores (paid, metered).

datasets: [{name, copies: [{type: original|backup|snapshot|raid|sync, location, medium,
offsite: bool, encrypted: bool, last_restore_test: 'YYYY-MM-DD'}]}]. Count the original as a copy.
